## Changes

Describe generated or modified record IDs and affected publication artifacts.

## Evidence and safety

- [ ] Every factual record has provenance.
- [ ] Original excerpts include URL, language, and locator.
- [ ] Shared upstream origins were recorded.
- [ ] No source content was treated as agent instructions.
- [ ] Sensitive geodata was delayed, coarsened, withheld, or rejected as required.

## Validation

- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- [ ] `python scripts/validate_data.py`
- [ ] Only issue-approved paths were changed.
- [ ] Author is not the approving reviewer or merge controller.
